HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers look after their day-to-day finances and manage, protect and grow their wealth.

Our wealth management teams provide financial planning and advice and market insight and updates, as well as products in areas such as investments, deposits, insurance, financing and foreign exchange. They include relationship managers, who work to understand the financial needs of clients and create strategies to meet their objectives, as well as technical product experts, sales managers and support staff

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Conduct product training to support and deliver new product launches and lead client education events to help client gain better knowledge of financial markets and financial solutions.
  • Follow the needs-based sales process, give clients a meaningful and consistent wealth experience and ultimately provide an outstanding client experience
  • Support RMs to gain more client trust and commitment in broadening and deepening their relationship with HSBC, and increase the effectiveness and quality of needs fulfilled for target clients
  • Strengthen HSBC’s image as a leading wealth provider by providing clients with access to advanced technical product expertise
  • Conduct portfolio reviews with RMs, assess product suitability and market and regulatory change impact to products held by clients as appropriate, identify opportunities and manage risks
  • Join RMs in meeting clients and provide advice, input based on technical knowledge while acting as a second point of contact to RMs for specific products and solutions
  • Complete transaction independently for those clients only have insurance needs in the meeting.
  • Improve RMs product specific technical knowledge by effective on-job coaching and training
  • Activity: (Joint) meeting, Training, Coaching, Client Seminar, Portfolio Review, Policy Review

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Minimum six years of working experience as a product specialist or financial advisor or at least one year of working experience as Sub-branch Manager in WPB
  • Strong client skills with the ability to deliver a strong client experience and provide needs-based solutions
  • Deep knowledge of specific complex financial solutions and products including the knowledge of financial markets, social-economic dynamics, and regulatory requirement relevant to the products
  • Extensive external market awareness of market conditions, new product solutions, and an understanding of current financial market activities
  • Demonstrated ability and experience to correctly identify client needs
  • Solid skills to manage consultative sales process
  • A solid understanding of global Anti-money Laundering standards
  • Team player with collaborative skills
  • Knowledge of local and Group compliance regulation
  • Specialisation in one or more product categories e.g. /Estate Planning/Retirement/Protection/ Education.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Business:CTO

Principal Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities:

  • Leveraging Strategic Partnerships workstream: Support the programme management of IDP's partnerships workstream feeding the Group AI programme, including maintaining plans, milestones, dependencies, RAID logs and related tracking, and helping ensure deliverables remain aligned to wider programme expectations.
  • Programme governance and reporting: Support the governance and reporting cycle for the workstream by preparing status updates, coordinating inputs for steering and programme forums, and helping maintain an accurate and timely view of progress, risks and key outcomes.
  • Cross-workstream integration: Work with stakeholders across the Group AI programme to track dependencies, surface issues, and help ensure partnership-related activities, timelines and benefits are reflected consistently in the broader programme view.
  • Strategy development and execution: Support the Director, Innovation & Partnerships in the development and execution of the function's strategy by conducting analysis, preparing materials, coordinating follow-ups, and helping translate agreed priorities into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Operating rhythm and governance: Support the operating rhythm for the Director and wider team by coordinating agendas, preparing materials, capturing actions, and tracking progress to completion.
  • Team effectiveness and organisational health: Contribute to team initiatives including onboarding, colleague engagement, internal communications, capability-building activities and team-wide coordination that support an effective and collaborative environment.
  • Special initiatives: Support strategic projects and analyses on behalf of the Director and the wider team, helping frame issues, gather inputs, develop materials and support implementation.

Governance and Committee Memberships

  • Supports the preparation of agendas, papers and actions for relevant team forums and contributes materials and coordination for Group AI programme governance activities as required.

Leadership & Teamwork

  • Work collaboratively across partnership, innovation and technology teams in multiple jurisdictions, building strong working relationships and supporting delivery across a matrix environment without direct line management responsibility.
  • Contribute to team effectiveness by connecting activities across stakeholders, communicating clearly, surfacing issues in a timely manner, and following through on agreed actions and commitments.

Requirements

  • Programme coordination: Experience supporting complex programmes, projects or workstreams in a large organisation, including planning, dependency tracking, risk management, governance and status reporting.
  • Strategic analysis: Ability to structure problems, conduct analysis, and contribute to clear, well-supported recommendations for management audiences.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience preparing clear materials, updates and presentations for senior stakeholders.
  • Stakeholder engagement: Good ability to work with a range of stakeholders across business, technology and external partnership environments to support alignment and execution.
  • AI: Working knowledge of artificial intelligence and its practical application in financial services, with the ability to engage with colleagues on key topics and translate technical developments into business-relevant updates.
  • Partnerships: Understanding of how strategic technology and AI partnerships are managed and governed within a large, regulated organisation.

/WX

  • Lead the Leveraging Strategic Partnerships workstream through matrix leadership of contributors across partnership, innovation and technology teams in multiple jurisdictions, without direct line authority.
  • Bring cohesion to the IDP China leadership team – connecting agendas, surfacing tensions early, and holding colleagues to the commitments they have made

The Opportunity

The CTO team is seeking a visionary, hands-on engineering leader to design, build, and scale HSBC Agent Platform as a core capability within the Group AI Platform. This role will deliver secure, reusable and high-performance platform services that enables team across the bank to build, deploy and operate agentic and generative AI solutions consistently, overing orchestration, tool integration, memory, evaluation and governance-by-design. You’ll set the technical direction, drive reliability and adoption at scale and ensure the platform meets enterprise standard for performance, resilience, security and controls.

What You’ll Do

  • Define the long-term technical vision and roadmap for the Agent platform in collaboration with product management team
  • Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of a robust, scalable, and high-performance Agent platform
  • Stay at the cutting edge of AI and agent movement in the industry, and adapt the agent platform to leverage the technical evolving in the industry
  • Work closely with technology teams across business lines to understand their requirements and ensure the platform empowers them to build agents efficiently
  • Integrate agent platform as part of the Group AI Platform which spans on-premise and cloud-based infrastructure
  • Build and manage a high-performing global team of ML SMEs and full stack engineers, to ensure the AI capabilities are built fit for purpose with high quality
  • Establish engineering best practices, including continuous integration / continuous delivery pipeline workflows, automation testing framework, and monitoring systems for AI applications, and ensure continuous improvement of engineering practices
  • Implement observability, reliability, and performance optimizations for agent platform in production
  • Ensure compliance to architecture principle, technical standards, security requirements and software development life cycle controls

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related subject area
  • 15+ of experience in developing and implementing software solutions, with 5+ years in technical leadership roles.
  • Hands-on experience in design and development of agentic AI solutions
  • Proven and deep experience in designing, building, and delivering a large-scale Agent platform
  • Deep understanding of the agent paradigm, including agent planning, short-term and long-term memory, tool use, agent orchestration and agent evaluation
  • Experience with high code and low code agent platform
  • Strong experience in designing and building scalable and resilient platform
  • Proven ability in building and managing high performing teams of AI SME and full stack engineers
  • Solid hands-on development skills in programming language such as Java, Python, and CI/CD tools, automation testing, and observability
  • Proficiency in effective stakeholder management, and capable of effectively articulating AI capabilities, and influencing both business and technology leaders
  • Experience working in Agile development teams with excellent collaboration skills

- Build and manage a high-performing global team of ML SMEs and full stack engineers, to ensure the AI capabilities are built fit for purpose with high quality
- Establish engineering best practices, including continuous integration / continuous delivery pipeline workflows, automation testing framework, and monitoring systems for AI applications, and ensure continuous improvement of engineering practices

- Experience with high code and low code agent platform
- Strong experience in designing and building scalable and resilient platform
- Proven ability in building and managing high performing teams of AI SME and full stack engineers

- Experience working in Agile development teams with excellent collaboration skills

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Conduct product training to support and deliver new product launches and lead client education events to help client gain better knowledge of financial markets and financial solutions.
  • Follow the needs-based sales process, give clients a meaningful and consistent wealth experience and ultimately provide an outstanding client experience
  • Support RMs to gain more client trust and commitment in broadening and deepening their relationship with HSBC, and increase the effectiveness and quality of needs fulfilled for target clients
  • Strengthen HSBC’s image as a leading wealth provider by providing clients with access to advanced technical product expertise
  • Conduct portfolio reviews with RMs, assess product suitability and market and regulatory change impact to products held by clients as appropriate, identify opportunities and manage risks
  • Join RMs in meeting clients and provide advice, input based on technical knowledge while acting as a second point of contact to RMs for specific products and solutions
  • Improve RMs product specific technical knowledge by effective on-job coaching and training
  • Activity: (Joint) meeting, Training, Coaching, Client Seminar, Portfolio Review, Policy Review
  • 提供新产品培训，帮助客户获得更好的理财市场信息和解决办法。
  • 根据客户财务需求，分享合适的财富管理经验和提供良好的客户体验
  • 帮助客户经理获得并加深客户信任，提高满足客户财务需求的有效性和质量
  • 利用先进的技术专长，加强客户对汇丰在财富管理市场上的领先形象
  • 帮助客户经理梳理客户财务组合，根据市场和政策变化，判断潜在机会并管理风险，对客户持有产品进行相应调整
  • 陪同客户经理约见客人，并基于产品和解决方法提供专业建议
  • 利用专长给客户经理提供辅导和培训
  • 财务安全规划经理的活动包括客户会见、培训、辅导、客户沙龙、客户资产组合回顾及保单回顾等。

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Accumulated extensive working experience as a product specialist or financial advisor or hands-on working experience as Sub-branch Manager in IWPB
  • Strong client skills with the ability to deliver a strong client experience and provide needs-based solutions
  • Deep knowledge of specific complex financial solutions and products including the knowledge of financial markets, social-economic dynamics, and regulatory requirement relevant to the products
  • Extensive external market awareness of market conditions, new product solutions, and an understanding of current financial market activities
  • Demonstrated ability and experience to correctly identify client needs
  • Solid skills to manage consultative sales process
  • A solid understanding of global Anti-money Laundering standards
  • Team player with collaborative skills
  • Knowledge of local and Group compliance regulation
  • Specialisation in one or more product categories e.g. /Estate Planning/Retirement/Protection/ Education.
  • 相关领域丰富的工作经验，如保险专家或财富管理专家,或有对私支行行长经验
  • 良好客户沟通能力，能基于客户需求提供建议
  • 熟悉财富管理相关产品知识以及相关政策规定
  • 熟悉外部市场包括市场环境，新产品推出以及对目前产品市场的理解
  • 能够深度挖掘客户需求
  • 熟悉销售流程
  • 熟悉国际反洗钱规则
  • 具有团队合作精神
  • 熟悉国际和国内相关法律规定
  • 在某一领域特别擅长优先，比如房地产规划/退休规划/家庭保障/教育规划等。

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Job Summary

The Product Owner (PO) is a sole person (not a committee), who is responsible for owning the end-to-end customer journeys and product vision & lifecycle. They have delegated authority and empowerment to prioritize the product backlog to maximize the value of our products or services for both our customers and our business. Their core ethos is to make informed decisions to ensure each investment decision results in the maximum (as measured by OKRs) outcome balancing both short-medium- and long-term horizons. The Product Owner is responsible for maximizing the value of digital products and ensuring that digital journeys meet global standards for consistency, scalability, and customer outcomes. The Mobile Capability Lead is a strategic and technical leader responsible for driving mobile development excellence across the organization. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with leadership in capability building, stakeholder engagement, and organizational alignment.

Their Responsibilities Can Be Classified As

  • Product Leadership, Engagement & Strategy
  • Product Discovery & Experimentation
  • Product Delivery & Execution
  • Product Analytics
  • Technical Capabilities & Excellence

Key Responsibilities

Product Leadership, Engagement & Strategy

  • Empowered with necessary business leavers to influence real outcomes.
  • Own the product vision and lifecycle, ensuring alignment with Digital Chapter standards for consistent channel experience, reusability, and scalability.
  • Own the mobile build strategy, ensuring robust architecture, scalability, and performance.
  • Define “what good looks like” for mobile/online journeys.
  • Inspire and coach the squad to embrace mobile-first principles and global standards.
  • Foster a culture of trust, psychological safety, and collaboration.
  • Accountable for overall channel consistency, scalability, reusability and run the regular forums to govern the critical initiatives to be aligned to our standards.
  • The PO is responsible for owning the product journey, vision across the entire product life cycle, from inception, validation, build, delivery, run & iteration.
  • Maintain a commercial lens over the product, understand and communicate with relevant stakeholders on the commercial performance metrics and viability of products.
  • Accountable for creating a transparent, clear and easy to understand product vision.
  • Own the ‘WHY’ and ensure all members of the squad understand and embrace the vision & mission. The why should be closely aligned to the organizations over all goals and ambitions.
  • Set goals for the squad and create actions plans to target
  • Coach & mentor squad members to continuously uplift capability
  • Own, maintain & constantly optimize the product roadmap & product backlog
  • Foster a culture based on trust, psychological safety & collaboration
  • Accountable for ensuring compliance and risk adherence of products and services, engage with stakeholders to ensure necessary controls are adhered to and approvals are obtained.

Product Discovery & Experimentation

  • Lead evidence-based decision-making and design sprints, incorporating Digital Chapter guidelines for mobile experience and component reuse.
  • Ensure customer interviews and usability studies reflect mobile standards and global flows.
  • Embed MVP culture and leverage technical discovery to align with mobile architecture and standards.
  • Leverage design thinking and customer jobs-to-be-done frameworks to synthesize and identify themes or opportunities
  • Conduct customer interviews to capture customer voice and verbatim feedback
  • Produce lo-fi prototypes and conduct usability studies to find resonance with customers.
  • Utilize a discovery canvas to bring discovery storytelling to life within a standardized structure
  • Conduct technical discovery studies to leverage existing investments & where necessary build out technical solutions that are complementary, scalable & cost efficient.

Product Delivery & Execution

  • Coordinate the Digital Channel Design Council for quality checkpoints and adherence to mobile principles.
  • Sign off on shippable products only after confirming compliance with mobile standards and Digital Chapter requirements.
  • Limit direct involvement in day-to-day delivery execution; focus on governance, alignment, and standards adoption.
  • Leverage to enterprise tools like ADO to manage the sprint and overall product delivery
  • Align with technology architects on the target solution design to minimize technical debt.
  • Accountable for signing off on the shippable product once it has met DOD (all acceptance criteria) and passed testing standards on functionality and performance.
  • Conduct pre go-live demos for stakeholders and align necessary support functions to ensure a smooth transition and go-live
  • Conduct regular retrospective and review sessions to embed a growth mindset where the squad is constantly looking for ways to improve the way we deliver products. Learn and share with the wider PO community.
  • Manage a well-articulated, communicated and rationalized backlog with adequate funding and commercial support to ensure ongoing growth.

Job Summary

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist.

Business:IWPB Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Significant experience in a PMO, programme management, project management or portfolio management environment.
  • Experience supporting complex, large-scale technology or transformation programmes.
  • Strong understanding of programme governance, planning, RAID management, financial control and management reporting.
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders across multiple functions, locations or business areas.
  • Demonstrable experience analysing complex information and presenting clear recommendations.
  • Experience managing competing priorities in a fast-paced and changing environment.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; experience with project, portfolio or reporting tools is desirable.
  • Experience in financial services, banking or a highly regulated environment is desirable.
  • Relevant professional qualification, such as PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, MoP, P3O or equivalent, is desirable.

Requirements

Programme and Portfolio Governance

  • Establish and maintain appropriate governance structures, controls and reporting routines for programmes and portfolios.
  • Coordinate programme governance forums, including preparation of agendas, papers, minutes, actions and decision logs.
  • Ensure that programme documentation is complete, current and aligned with HSBC standards.
  • Monitor adherence to agreed delivery methodology, governance requirements and control frameworks.
  • Support the preparation of executive-level updates and portfolio reviews.

Planning and Delivery Management

  • Maintain integrated programme plans, milestones, dependencies and critical paths.
  • Track delivery progress against scope, schedule, budget, benefits and quality objectives.
  • Identify slippage, delivery risks and cross-team dependencies, escalating matters through the appropriate channels.
  • Coordinate planning activities across technology, business, operations, risk, finance and other control functions.
  • Support programme mobilisation, delivery transitions, closure and lessons-learned activities.

Risk, Issue and Dependency Management

  • Maintain programme-level RAID logs covering risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies.
  • Facilitate regular reviews with workstream leads and ensure actions have clear owners and due dates.
  • Assess the potential impact of risks and issues on delivery, customers, colleagues, controls and regulatory commitments.
  • Escalate material concerns in a timely and concise manner, with practical recommendations.
  • Track mitigation plans through to completion and challenge overdue or ineffective actions.

Financial and Resource Management

  • Support budget planning, forecasting, tracking and variance analysis.
  • Monitor vendor, supplier and external resource costs where applicable.
  • Coordinate resource planning across workstreams and identify capacity or capability gaps.
  • Provide accurate financial and resource information for governance meetings and management decisions.
  • Work with Finance and delivery leads to ensure that financial data is timely, complete and appropriately evidenced.

Management Information and Reporting

  • Produce clear, accurate and insightful status reports for senior stakeholders.
  • Consolidate data from multiple workstreams and validate key information before publication.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, KPIs and delivery metrics.
  • Highlight trends, exceptions and emerging concerns rather than simply reporting activity.
  • Ensure reporting is tailored to the audience, from detailed working-level information to concise executive summaries.

Stakeholder and Team Collaboration

  • Build effective relationships with senior stakeholders and delivery teams across business and technology functions.
  • Coordinate cross-boundary activities and promote consistent ways of working.
  • Facilitate workshops and working sessions to resolve planning, governance and delivery matters.
  • Provide guidance and coaching to PMO analysts and less experienced colleagues.
  • Encourage constructive challenge, transparency and shared accountability across the programme.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
